body.statement: Can the handle \(\mathsf A_{\rm chart}\) be completed into a degeneracy-safe exact algorithm that emits all feasible full-dimensional rational endpoint charts, all singular and lower-dimensional strata, all model-infeasible and target-empty labels, and sparse liftable endpoint certificates, with total bit complexity bounded by \(\operatorname{poly}(\ell_{\rm in},m,K)(M_{\rm out}+1)\) and with no uncharged exponential enumeration of rejected bases?
body.justification: A finite all-bases construction does not certify scalable symbolic sensitivity analysis; the open theorem asks for complexity charged to the actual econometric output.
body.gap: Columbano, Fukuda, and Jones charge work to perturbed sufficient-matrix critical domains, and Jones, Kerrigan, and Maciejowski output a nonoverlapping perturbed optimizer; neither guarantee matches the unperturbed stratified ratio-chart output.
body.consumer: A positive answer would make exact whole-surface reporting practical when many covariate cells remain orientation-ambiguous.

obligation.what_is_open: A completeness and bit-complexity proof for the degeneracy-safe adjacency-and-stratification algorithm \(\mathsf A_{\rm chart}\), including discovery of disconnected feasible chart components and canonical handling of singular and lower-dimensional ties.
obligation.obstruction: Finite active-set enumeration proves termination but can inspect exponentially many infeasible, singular, duplicate, or nonoptimal bases that emit no chart or certificate. No charging map from those rejected bases to the encoded output is available, and fixed-matrix parametric-LP arguments do not apply directly because the minority-budget row itself depends on \(\delta_S\).
obligation.attempted: The exact finite sign-stratification fallback, canonical active-basis certificates, determinant-zero strata, pointwise normalized LPs, and sparse full-law lifting were derived. Adjacency traversal was considered, but without a certified component-discovery mechanism and duplicate-work bound it does not establish the requested output-sensitive guarantee.
obligation.partial_result: The proved finite fallback enumerates every orientation and every full-rank active set, retains zero-sign strata, compares all feasible positive-denominator vertex ratios exactly, and attaches active-set, emptiness, and sparse full-law certificates.  Pointwise endpoints require at most \(2^{r_{\rm amb}+1}\) rational linear programs for rational inputs.  What remains unproved is the stronger bound \(\operatorname{poly}(\ell_{\rm in},m,K)(M_{\rm out}+1)\): the fallback can inspect exponentially many singular, infeasible, duplicate, or nonoptimal active sets that produce no emitted chart.
